stem.text: Dolomite is a double carbonate, $\text{CaMg(CO}_3\text{)}_2$, and can be used instead of calcium carbonate for treating acidic soils.
The three statements all refer to the agricultural use of these carbonates.

items: Dolomite and calcium carbonate are both less soluble than $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$.
One mole of dolomite has the same neutralising effect as one mole of calcium carbonate.
Dolomite and calcium carbonate both increase the pH of acidic soils.
